change_description: Added unified _get_proportions helper that gracefully falls back to uniform weighting (1.0 / count) when total_samples <= 0, resolving ZeroDivisionError across FedAdam, FedAdaGrad, FedYogi, and SCAFFOLD.
Strictly validate layer count, individual tensor shapes, and total flat element count in ModelService.set_parameters, raising descriptive ValueError on mismatch and using strict=True in zip.
Sanitize and clamp client sample counts to non-negative integers (clean_samples.append(max(0, int(s)))) to prevent negative sample weight inversion.

Generate unique ephemeral IDs for unkeyed aggregation calls (simulation_id=None) and prune state immediately post-aggregation, preventing shared static 'default_sim' memory leaks and cross-run state pollution.
Added structured logger.warning when zero client updates are collected in a round, ensuring operational visibility during total client failure edge cases.
